item.title: Esjay US Recalls Toddler Busy Board Montessori Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking; Violates Small Parts Ban
item.company: Shenzhen Yishijie Technology Co., Ltd., dba Esjay US, of China
item.brand: Shenzhen Yishijie Technology Co., Ltd., dba Esjay US, of China
item.product: Esjay Toddler Busy Board Montessori Toys
item.summary: This recall involves Esjay Toddler Busy Board Montessori Toys. The busy boards are made of blue felt, have carrying handles, elastic cords and button closures. The front is printed with various cartoon dinosaurs, and the back is printed with 26 small squares, each corresponding to a letter of the alphabet. Each square contains the letter and a cartoon animal. The busy boards have five pages in total and the page with red knobs is the second page.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Esjay Toddler Busy Board Montessori Toys.
item.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled toy away from children, stop using it immediately and contact Esjay for instructions on the repair. Consumers will be asked to unzip the page with red knobs, write “RECALLED” on both sides of the page and throw it away. Send a photo of the disposed page to Esjay US at esjay-service@outlook.com to receive a replacement page.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
